verbetes.glosa_atual: canteiro ou sulco da extremidade; equivalente aramaico de אוֹמָן.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. I Lev. XIX, 9 (h. text פאה); Targ. Y. II ib. אוֹ מִן (read אוֹמַן). Ib. v. 27 Ar. (ed. צדדי), XXI, 5 (of the beard, h. text פאת זקנך).

verbetes.glosa_atual: artífice; artesão; trabalhador especializado; fabricante profissional; cozinheiro ou arquiteto.
definicoes_originais: skilled, artist, artisan, professional cook, architect &c. Ab. Zar. 34 b מורייס א' brine prepared by a professional manufacturer and dealer.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 1 מדעת א' after the plan of an architect. Pesik. R. s. 11 שאינו א' וכ' who is not skilled in climbing up.; a. fr.— Pl. אוּמָנִין Ber. 16 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: artesão; perito; profissional qualificado; equivalentes aramaicos de אוּמָן.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXI, 10 (adj.). Targ. Ex. XXVI, 1; a. e.—Snh. 29 a (prov.) שב שני וכ' seven years a famine may last, but the artisan’s gate it will not cross. Sabb. 133 b האי א' the surgeon (who circumcises). B. Mets. 97 a טבחא וא' the butcher and the surgeon (of the community).— Pl. אוּמָנִין, אוּמָנַיָּא. Targ. I Chr. IX, 30. Targ. II Kings XXIV, 14; a. e. Y. Ber. IV, 13 a top, as one uses promiscuously the words אומנון בניין וכ' (read אומנין) artisans, builders, architects.

verbetes.glosa_atual: canteiro frontal ou canteiro de extremidade; ver אוֹמַן.
ver אוּמָן; variante aramaica.
notas_originais: , v. אוּמָן ch.

notas_originais: , v. אוֹמָנוּתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוּמַן; remissão.

verbetes.glosa_atual: a fonte recomenda ler אֲמָנוֹס; ver אֲמָנָה II.
notas_originais: , read אֲמָנוֹס, v. אֲמָנָה II

verbetes.glosa_atual: habilidade; ofício; profissão; trabalho artesanal; fabricação exigida pelo governo; por extensão, arte, expediente ou recurso.
definicoes_originais: באומנותם through their skill; a. fr.— the workmanship (or its equivalent) to be furnished the (Roman) government.
notas_originais: Kid. IV, 14.—בעל א' mechanic. Ḥull. 54 b.—בן אומנותוֹ one’s fellow-tradesman, competitor. Gen. R. s. 32, beg.—Ber. 43 b כל אחד ואחד יִפָּה לו וכ' to each man the Lord made his trade appear nice. Y. Succ. V, end, 55 d (play on be- ĕ munatham I Chron. IX, 2

B. Bath. IX, 4. Y. Dem. VI, end, 26 a; Tosef. Dem. VI, 4; cmp. אוֹצָר.— Pl. אוּמָנִיּוֹת. Gen. R. s. 24. Num. R. s. 15 קורא א' invited people by trades (each day another trade); Tanḥ. B’haăl., 3 קורא בכל יום א'.—Trnsf. arts, devices. Ex. R. s. 47, end כל הצדיקים באו בא' all the righteous (in their pleas and prayers) came with devices before the Lord (as Abraham prayed in behalf of fifty, forty &c.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ofício; habilidade; trabalho artesanal; forma aramaica relacionada a אוּמָנוּת.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XXXV, 33; a. e.—Macc. 8 b; a. e.—Koh. R. to III, 9 מאי מהני אומנה באוּמָנוּתֵיה what does the artist profit by his skill? Y. Git. V, 47 b bot. יהבין בניהון לא' indenture their children as apprentices; Y. B. Bath. X, 17 c bot. לאומנתה (corr. acc.). Sabb. 103 a חזי א' וכ' sees a mechanical contrivance on a Sabbath and learns it. Y. Keth. IV, 28 d אמנותא (corr acc.), v. טְרִיקְלֵין.— Pl. אוּמַנְוָותָא, אוּמַנְוָן; אוּמַנְוָון. Targ. Ex. l. c. Targ. II Esth VI, 12; a. fr. [Y. Ber. IV, 13 a top, v. אוּמַן.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma feminina ou plural relacionada a אוֹמָן; remissão morfológica.
ver אִמְפְּרָטוֹר; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אִמְפְּרָטוֹר

verbetes.glosa_atual: pedaço grosso de carne que pode ser comido cru após preparação por pressão; plural אוּמְצֵי.
notas_originais: (אמץ) a thick piece of meat, a piece which can be eaten raw after pressing &c. Sabb. 128 a חזי לא' fit to be eaten raw. Ḥull. 44 b א' מעלייתא a fine piece &c.; a. fr.— Pl. אוּמְצֵי. Git. 69 a שב א' seven pieces.

verbetes.glosa_atual: franja; orla; borda de tecido; ver אִימְרָה.
povo; nação; formas plurais variadas, incluindo אוּמִּין e אוּמַּיָּא.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Deut. XXIX, 12; a. e. Midr. Prov. to XXX, 28; a. e.— Pl. אוּמִּין. Targ. Y. Gen. XXV, 3. Gen. R. s. 61. אוּמַּיָּא־, אוּמַּיָּיא; אוּמֵּי. Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 1.—Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 6 שנאיהון דא' those hated by the nations.—Sabb. 32 a.—אוּמָּאתָא, אוּמָּתָא. Targ. Prov. XXIV, 24.

verbetes.glosa_atual: juramento; forma aramaica relacionada a אוֹמָאָה.
opressão e injustiça; também falsidade ou vaidade; uso polêmico em expressão aplicada aos Evangelhos na literatura rabínica.
definicoes_originais: √או = עו to curve, be curved, hollow; to press, be pressed; v. אוי, אוגיא &c.; comp. חו, חב, גו, גב, עב)
notas_originais: א' גִּלְיוֹן a cacophemistic adaptation of εὐαγγέλιον (v. גליון). Sabb. 116 a bot. (after לסכוניה, omitted in ed.) דר' מאיר א' ג' ר' יוחנן קרי ליה עון גליון (Rashi Ms. ר' מאיר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) R. Meïr called the gospel falsehood of blank paper (or of revelation), R. Yoḥ. called it sin of &c. [Ib. several times עון גליון or און ג' in Ms. a. older editions, for אירייתא אחריתי &c. in recent ed., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: posse; bens; poder; força.
notas_originais: Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 16 (IV, beg.) כתב לו או̇נו̇ if he (the seller of the slave) wrote to him (gave him in writing) the liberty of his disposal of himself, i.e. that the slave, if he should run away from the buyer, would not be claimed by him who sold him; Git. 43 b כתב עליו אונו (read אליו or לו). Ib. מאי אונו what means ‘his own possession’? Ans. He wrote to him this, ‘If thou run away from him (the purchaser), I have nothing to do with thee. Ib. 85 b.—[Y. B. Mets. I, end, 8 a; Y. Kid. I, 60 c אונו, v. אוֹנִי.] V. אוֹנָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pousada noturna; estação de viagem; lugar de alojamento para viajantes.
definicoes_originais: (v. foreg. ws.; cmp. גנן, חָנָה, חוּן, a. עוֹנָה, מָעוֹן) [circle], night-lodging, station for travellers (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Mansio).
notas_originais: Naz. 7 a כל אוו' וא' every station. B. Mets. 79 b; Ab. Zar. 65 a מא' לא' from station to station.—Deut. R. s. 6 she dared to bring disorder into אוננא של מלך (read אוונא or אַוְונָה, v. infra) the royal head quarters. Pl. אַוְונִין, אֲוָונִין. Targ. Is. X, 32 (ed. Vien. אַוְנִין). [Sabb. 157 b אוונא, v. אוּדְנָא II.] [Comment. use h. forms אַוְונָה, pl. אַוְונוֹת.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Avana; topônimo associado ao rio Tigre.
definicoes_originais: , אֲוָונָא pr. n. pl. (v. foreg.) Avana, on the Tigris.
notas_originais: Kid. 71 b אכברא וא' Ar. ed. Koh (oth. ed. Ar. אכבדא); Talm. ed. בגדא ואוונא [Var. בגדת] Okhbara and Avana as bordertowns of Babylonia (v. De Sacy Chrest. Ar. I, p. 358 sq.; Koh. in Ar. s. v.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Nakis Una, possivelmente nome de pessoa gentia; identificação expressamente incerta.
definicoes_originais: , נקיס א' pr. n. m. Nakis Una(?), a gentile name.
notas_originais: Git. 11 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: orelha; alça de recipiente; lobo pulmonar.
notas_originais: Git. 69 b. Sabb. 108 a top.

Ḥull. 59 b; a. fr.— Pl. אוּנֵי. Ib. 38 a אזוזי א' moving the ears (as a sign of life in the last stages). Yeb. 60 b מפיקנא … מאוניך we shall get R. … out of thy ears, i.e. we shall make thee give up thy authority (a threat of excommunication). Gen. R. s. 45 אוניך דחמר thy ears are those of an ass.—Ḥull. 47 a ה' אוני וכ' the lungs have five lobes; a. fr. [Later Rabb. literature uses אוּמָא, v. אוּם, for the large lump from which the lobes branch off.] V. אוּנִין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: injustiça ou opressão, inclusive por palavras; no direito comercial, fraude, cobrança abusiva ou lesão contratual com possibilidade de reparação.
definicoes_originais: (law) imposition, overreaching, fraudulent representation (which invalidates the transaction or requires redress); hence, redress in case of overreaching.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 58 b גדולה אוֹנָאַת דברים מא' ממון the wrong you do by means of words (wounding one’s feelings) is worse than that by pecuniary imposition. Ib. 59 a לעולם יהא … באוֹנָאַת אשתו וכ' one should always be on his guard not to wound his wife’s feeling, for as her tears are frequent אוֹנָאָתָהּ מרובה so is her sense of wrong (sensibility) deep.

Y. B. Mets. IV, 9 d top, a. fr. whoever concludes a bargain במנת שאין לו א' וכ' with the provision that no legal redress shall be resorted to, is notwithstanding entitled to redress.— Denomin. Verb (אוֹנָה), Hithpa. הִתְאוֹנֶה to be imposed upon, to feel one’s self overreached. Y. B. Mets. IV, 9 d top. בשעה שהמוכר מִתְאוֹנֶה וכ' if the seller sues for undue advantage taken of him, he has the privilege of redress, provided the advantage amounts to one fifth or more of the price charged; if the buyer sues &c. [In Babli the denomin. verb is אִינָּה, v. אני.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנָאִיתָא; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנָאִיתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אַנְדִּיפֵי; variantes אונדפא e אונדפי.
notas_originais: , v. אַנְדִּיפֵי

definicoes_originais: to oppress, v. אני, and אוֹנָאָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: posse; título de propriedade; escritura ou documento comprobatório.
definicoes_originais: (v. אוֹן) possession, title of possession, deed.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 79 (ref. to the letters יה in קשיֹטהֹ Gen. XXXIII, 19) יו"ד ה"א כותב הא' וכ' Yod He (i.e. the Lord) writes the deed; the Lord bears witness to the deed.— Pl. אוֹנוֹת. B. Bath. 52 a א' ושטרות וכ' deeds of purchase and other documents were issued in his name.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנִי I; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנִי I

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ono; topônimo situado a oeste-noroeste de Jerusalém.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Ono, W.
notas_originais: N. W. of Jerusalem. Cant. R. to II, 2; Lam. R. to I, 17. Snh. 11 b איש א' Ms. M. (ed. אוני); a. fr. V. אוֹנִי II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנֵיס; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנֵיס

verbetes.glosa_atual: polia ou dispositivo de suporte empregado por pessoa com deficiência de locomoção; termo associado ao grego ὄνος.
definicoes_originais: , א' קִטְמִין (v. אָנְקִטְמִין; ὄνος) the pulley of the crippled.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. VI, 8 c. (Var. הוניס.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: realmente!; verdadeiramente!; de fato!; do grego ὄντως.
definicoes_originais: (ὄντως) really! verily! Lev. R. s. 33, explain.
notas_originais: הצדא (Dan. III, 14); (Ar. אנטוס, some ed. אונטיס, corr. acc.); Num. R. s. 15 אנטוס (Tanḥ. Noah 11 האמת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: variante textual em Tosefta Kelim; possível correção para אִצְטַלּוּת; leitura não firmada.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 6 ed. Zuck., ed. אצטלוס, Var. אצטלו' prob. אִצְטַלּוּת q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנָאָה; variantes אוני e אוֹנָה.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנָאָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma feminina equivalente a אוֹנָה; remissão a documento de posse.
notas_originais: [The phonetic coïncidence with ὠνή produced the peculiar use of our w. in connection with Greek terms, in the Palest. literature.] Gen. R. s. 2 beg. בא' אחת ובטימי וכ' in one bill of sale and for the same price. Y. Pes. IV, 31 b bot. מיסתיוסיס בא' היא וכ' (read מיסתוס') it is a lease with a title of possession (for the term), and is (for the time being) an acquisition like a purchase. Y. Kid. I, 60 c (אוני a. אונו); a. e.— Pl. אוֹנִיוֹת. Gen. R. s. 84, end כמה א' וכ' how many deeds were written for him (how many times was he sold)?, cmp. אוֹן. [Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 24; Pesik. Rosh. Hash. p. 151 a, v. אוֹנָיָה.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Bet-Oni; nome de localidade palestina, possivelmente identificada com Ono.
definicoes_originais: בית א' pr. n. pl. ( Beth) Oni in Palestine, prob. identic with אוֹנוֹ.
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebi. VII, 14 פגי בית א' (ed. Zuckerm. בֵיתְיַאנֵי, בֵיתְיַינֵי, Var. ביתיני) the unripe grapes of B. O. (Beth Yanai).—Y. Git. IV, 46 a א' אסור וכ' if a slave fled to Oni, he must not be extradited (because O. is a Palestinean place). V. הִינִי 3.

verbetes.glosa_atual: de Oni; ou antropônimo Onia, possivelmente Onias; análise alternativa na fonte.
definicoes_originais: m. (prob.) of Oni, v. foreg., or pr. n. m. Onya (= Onias?).
notas_originais: Y. Orl. I, 61 a top; Y. Sabb. I, 3 c; ib. d אנייא R. Joshua Onia, an Amora.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנָאִיתָא; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנָאִיתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: injustiça; opressão; por extensão, confisco e privação de posse; plural associado a medidas confiscatórias.
notas_originais: XLVI, 18) prop. oppression, wrong, hence confiscation, dispossession. Pl. אוֹנָיוֹת . Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 24 (play on oniyoth ibid.) אלו הא' וכ' those are the oppressive measures which they inflict upon Israel, which they order to be written out eveny day. *Pesik. R. Hash. p. 151 a; Yalk. Jer. 312 הוֹנָיוֹת וזמיות confiscations and fines (Yalk. Gen. 121; Lev. R. s. 29, a. e. ארנוניות, v. Buber Pesik. l. c. note).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוֹנְיָא; variante.
notas_originais: , v. אוֹנְיָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: Bet-Uniaki, identificada com a Bitínia na Ásia Menor; topônimo.
definicoes_originais: , בית א' pr. n. pl. Beth-Unyaki, Bithynia, in Asia Minor (cmp. Neub. Géogr. pp. 262; 422).
notas_originais: Yoma 10 a תובל זה בית א' (Ms. M. אונקי indistinct; oth. Var., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) Tubal means B. Ab. Zar. II, 4 (29 b) cheese of בית א' (Ms. M. אונקי, איניקי, Mish. Nap. ותינייקי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.). Tosef. Shebi. V, 9 הונייקי (ed. Zuck. גבינה ובית היניקי read גבינת ב' ה'); Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV, 13 בית הינייקי (Var. היניקאי). Cmp. וְתַנְיָה a. אַנְיָאקָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: feixes de linho úmido; provável plural de forma referente a orelha ou saliência.
definicoes_originais: (prob. pl. of אוּנָא ear) bundles of wet flax.
notas_originais: Sabb. I, 6. Y. Shebi. V, 36 a bot.; a. e. [Rashi a. Tosaf. to Succ. 12 b אונץ as a plur., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.; cmp. אָנִיץ.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: tirano; senhor; governante.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. II, 16; XVIII, 1.

verbetes.glosa_atual: documento de propriedade; título de posse; escritura, inclusive falsificada em exemplo rabínico.
notas_originais: Y. Taan. IV, 69 a והוו משלחין א' וכ' they would send the (forged) deed of sale to the steward; Lam. R. to II, 2 (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: injustiça; opressão; agravo.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 22 a א' דמלכא וכ' the wrong inflicted on the king of Edom. Lev. R. s. 33, beg. (ref. to Amos VII, 7, v. אֲנָךְ I) על שורא דא' upon the wall of (i.e. watching over) the wrongs (in sale and purchase); cmp. B. Mets. 59 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: conchas marinhas utilizadas para obter púrpura; Jastrow propõe corrigir para קוּנְכִין.
definicoes_originais: read קוּנְכִין m. pl. (κόγχη, concha) purple shells.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Num. XXXIII, 8; cmp. קוּנְכִי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲמַפְּלַי; remissão em Tosefta Shevuot.
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebu. VI, 4 ed. Zuck., v. אֲמַפְּלַי

verbetes.glosa_atual: comerciantes denominados avâncreus; possível etnônimo derivado de entreposto comercial; explicação incerta.
definicoes_originais: (prob. a nom. gentil., from a trading station named אוונכר, a compound of אוונא [a.
notas_originais: אִכָּר?]; cmp. אֲוָנָא) Avankreans(?), traders. Succ. 30 ab. [Ar. identifies our w. with אַכְוַנְגַּר which is not in agreement with the context.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אָנַן; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אָנַן

verbetes.glosa_atual: a fonte recomenda a leitura אַוְונָא; variante textual em Deuteronômio Rabá.
notas_originais: Deut. R. s. 6, read אַוְונָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אַנּוֹנָא; remissão em Levítico Rabá.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 23, v. אַנּוֹנָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: coação; força; compulsão; impedimento inevitável ou acidente.
notas_originais: Git. 30 a, a. e. אין א' בגיטין the plea of unavoidable interference cannot be raised in letters of divorce (to which a condition is attached). Y. M. Kat. III, 81 d bot., a. e. מחמת אוֹנְסוֹ through no fault of his.— Pl. אוֹנְסִים, אוֹנְסִין. Ned. III, 1, a. e. נדרי א' vows on conditions unavoidably unfulfilled.

verbetes.glosa_atual: injustiça; opressão; violência; homógrafo distinto.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. LVIII, 9; 13 מלין דא' offensive (violent) words (h. text אָוֶן, cmp. אוֹנָאָה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: força; violência; injustiça; roubo; ocorrência acidental.
definicoes_originais: (= h. אוֹנֶס, v. foreg.) force, wrong, robbery; accident.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXXI, 12; a. fr.—Git. 34 a. אי משום א' shall we take into consideration the possibility of an unavoidable accident?— Pl. אוֹנְסַיָּא. Ned. 27 b א' דמיגליא (read דמיגליי, Rashi אונסא) accidents which may be foreseen.

verbetes.glosa_atual: massa; volume; montão; em filosofia, corpo primitivo; também dificuldade, trabalho penoso ou preocupação.
definicoes_originais: bulk, pile ; (in philosophy) a primitive body.
notas_originais: Tanḥ. T’rum. 11 א' של מים the body of water; א' של אש (some ed. אונקנוס).

Gen. R. s. 12 (ref. to Neh. IX, 6 sq.) כל הא' הזה וכ' (ed. אונקים, corr. acc.) what is all this painstaking (creating the universe &c.) for? Ans. Because ‘thou art the Lord who hast chosen Abraham’ i.e. for the sake of establishing religion on earth; cmp. Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 18.

verbetes.glosa_atual: gancho recurvado, de formato semelhante ao pescoço; instrumento para prender ou agarrar.
notas_originais: — Pl. (אוּנְקָאוֹת) אוּנְקִיּוֹת. Kel. XII, 2 (Var. in Mish. ed. אוּנְקְלִיּוֹת). Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 4 (disting. from אוּנְקְלָאוֹת).—[
for אונקיא, v. next w.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: onça como medida, a duodécima parte de uma libra antiga; figuradamente, quantidade mínima ou partícula.
definicoes_originais: ounce, one twelfth of a litra.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 17 א' של כסף an ounce of silver. Lam. R. to I, 1 נסבון מן אונקא (העיר) (corr. acc.) they bought ounce-wise (pepper).

Y. Taan. IV, 68 c top there is not a generation in which there is not (to be atoned for through suffering) אונקי אחת וכ' (read אונקיא אחת) a particle of the sin of the calf-worship. Ex. R. s. 43, beg. אוקיא (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 29; Yalk. Gen. 47; Job. 908 (play on אי נקי Job. XXII, 30) א' אחת היתה וכ' only an ounce (of merit) did Noah possess; v. אינוניתא.— Pl. אוּנְקִיּוֹת. Gen. R. s. 79, end (play on the letters of ק̇ש̇י̇ט̇ה̇ Gen. XXXIII, 19) במאה אונקֹיות … ס̇לעים … ט̇לאים for one hundred (ק̇) ounces (of gold) &c. V. אוּקְיָא.

notas_originais: XL, 26.— Pl. אוּנְקְלִין. Targ. Y. Ex. XXVII, 10. Lev. (ed. ווי). Targ. Ez. XL, 43 (עֲנִקְלִין) עוּנְקְלִין.—Fem. pl. אוֹנְקַלְוָון. Targ. Y. Lev. X, 5. Targ. Esth. I, 6.—Targ. Y. II Ex. XXVI, 37 אַנְקְלַוָותְהוֹן their hooks.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Onkelos; personagem tradicionalmente associado à tradução aramaica do Pentateuco, frequentemente identificado com Áquila na tradição mencionada.
definicoes_originais: (Ocellus?) Onk’los, the alleged translator of the Pentateuch into Chaldaic, freq. surnamed הַגֵּר the proselyte; often identified with Aquila, the alleged author of a Greek translation of the Bible; v. עְקִילָס.
notas_originais: Cmp. Meg. 3 a; Ab. Zar. 11 a, with Tanḥ. Mishp. 5. Cant. R. to I, 11 אלקולאון q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: gancho ou suporte; carga pendurada em gancho; também cartilagem curvada, especialmente a extremidade xifoide do esterno, em contexto médico.
definicoes_originais: [cmp. ἀγκαλίς in S.] the load carried on the hook, the farmer’s load of sheaves or bunches; cmp. בלונקי.

Trnsf. (medic.) bent cartilage, esp. the cartilage (cart. ensiformis) at the end of the sternum which, being bent inside, presses on the stomach and creates nausea &c. Ab. Zar. 29 a מעלין א' וכ' you are permitted to lift the cartilage on the Sabbath (by means of a bandage &c.).
notas_originais: ; = אוּנְקַי; corresp. to b. h. לוּלַי; Greek adapt. ἀγκολη, LXX Ex. XXVI, 10; cmp. אוֹנִי as to contact of the two languages) prop. little ( camel’s) neck, hence

Kel. XII, 2 א' של כתפין Ar. (ed. אונקליות, אונקלין with adject. in the sing., corr. acc.) the carriers’ hook attached to their yoke, pole &c. Ib. א' של דרגש the hook of the bedstead (used for fastening the girths to the posts); של נקליטין the rack of the bed-curtain, v. נַקְלִיטִין. Ib. 3 א' שבכותלים hook attached to walls.—T’bul Yom IV, 6 ואנ' שלהם קיימת and the hook (attached to the now broken yoke) remained unimpaired; a. fr.— Pl. אוּנְקְלָאוֹת, אָנְקְ', (אונקלין) אוּנְקְלִיּוֹת. Tam. III, 5; Mid. III, 5; a. fr.—Kel. l. c.; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 4; v. אוּנְקַי.
Tosef. Maas. Sh. IV, 10. כל הא' the whole load. [Ib. 11 אונקולין, אונקלי, read with ed. Zuck. אינפולי].
Ib. מאי א' וכ' what unklay is meant? Ans. the cartilage in front of the heart; v. אִיסְתּוֹמְכָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: vestimenta leve e informal usada em casa ou sob o manto na rua; roupa interior cuja exibição pública podia ser considerada imprópria.
definicoes_originais: אוּנְקַל, נִקְלָה, נִיקְלַי f. (נקל, קל, cmp. esp. II Sam. VI, 20 to 2
the light garment, whence, a name for the easy dress worn in the house and, under the cloak, in the street, but in which it was unbecoming to appear in public. [Cmp.
notas_originais: II Sam. l. c. a. Num. R. s. 4; a. e.] Y. Yoma VI, 43 d top אוּנְקְלָה, נקלה, for which Men. 109 b אונקלי. Snh. 82 a he took off the point of his spear והניחה באונקלוֹ (some ed. לי—) and put it (hiding it) in his undergarment. M. Kat. 24 a אָבֵל מטייל בא' וכ' (Ms. M. מטייל אָבֵל) a mourner may walk on the Sabbath within the limits of his house (garden &c.) in the easy dress (showing the rent on account of a death in the family; Rashi). Sabb. 120 a (garments to be saved from fire on a Sabbath) אונקלי; Y. ib. XVI, 15 d top ניקלי.—Meg. IV, 8 (24 b) בית א'; (read as) Y. ib. a. Mss. בית יד א' the sleeve of his under-dress. [Tosef. Maas. Sh. IV, 11, v. foreg. 2.]

notas_originais: m. pl., prob. מוֹסָאֵי, name of a tribe. Targ. Ps. CXX, 5, v. אוֹסיא (some ed. אונאי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: nariz; narinas; forma plural com variantes אַוְסֵי e אוּסֵי.
notas_originais: into או; cmp. אַף, אָנַף; also אֶפֶס) nose, nostrils. Sabb. 67 a ואאוסי דגוריתא and on the nostrils of the young lioness. B. Bath. 73 b דסליק עליה באוסיה אכלה טינא ומית Ms. R. (ed. דיתבא ליה אכלה טינא באוסי', Ms. M. אבלה, Ar. ed. Koh. incorr., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) into whose nostrils a ‘mud-eater’ (worm) entered, and the fish died. Pes. 112 a ידא אאוסיא וכ' (Ms. M. a. Ar. א־פגא) putting the hand to the nose is a step to fear (indicating anxiety). Ḥull. 67 b ועיילי באוסַיֵּיה and they (the worms) creep into its nostrils.

notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 49 אוסי (corr. acc.).—Num. R. s. 23 שפחות מן א' וכ' maid-servants from another estate. Y. Taan. IV, 69 a; Lam. R. to II, 2 אי' (corr. acc.). Lev. R. s. 34.— Pl. אוּסִיּוֹת. Ex. R. s. 20. Ch. pl. אוּסְיָאן, אוּסְיָיאן. Lev. R. s. 3, beg. he likes to be called מרי אס' (corr. acc.) lord of many estates; Koh. R. to IV, 6 אוסייאס (corr. acc.).

notas_originais: גמלא דא' landing board. Snh. 67 b וקם אג' דא' Ar. (ed. וקם ג' דוסקנ' read with Rashi דסקונ', Ms. M. איסקניתא, oth. var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) and he found himself standing on a landing board (ed. and there stood before him &c.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: natureza; índole; ver אֹופִי; homógrafo da partícula precedente.
ramos; gravetos, especialmente galhos secos ou feixes de pequenos ramos.
definicoes_originais: (= עֳפִי Dan. IV, 9; cmp. b. h. עָנָף, a. אִיבָּא, אִנְבָּא) branches, esp. dry twigs, spray-wood.
notas_originais: Ber. 44 b א' פרסייתא twigs of Persian trees. Ḥull. 105 a פתכא דא' Ar. (ed. אופיי) a bundle of twigs. B. Mets. 30 b. Git. 61 a שדי אופיי (Ar. אופי) threw twigs down (which he cut off), and dates fell off (v. Tossaf. a. l.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: rosto; aparência; fisionomia; por extensão, natureza, disposição, índole e costumes.
definicoes_originais: f. (אֹוף m.) (b. h. אַפַּיִם; v. אַפָּא; cmp. אֹוף I) face, looks, whence, nature, disposition, ways &c. Y. Shek. I, 45 d אין אתה יכול לעמוד על א' של וכ' You cannot understand the nature of that people.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 30 אופוֹ של דוד Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. pr. אופי, ed. אפו) David’s ways. Y’lamd. Vaëthḥ. (quot. in Ar.) ‘who is that nation’ שהיא יודעת אופו של אלוהיה Ar. ed. Koh. (oth. ed. אופי) that knows the ways of her God (what he desires &c.); v. Yalk. Deut. 825.—Gen. R. s. 14 end נשמה זו הא' n’shamah (breath, soul) means the disposition, character, as people say האוֹפִיתָא טבא the good nature!
